Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Two friends of mine, a Black student and a Middle Eastern student applied to the same college with the same GPA, SAT scores, and extracurriculars. Only one of the two was accepted. The Black student didn't have any special qualifications and was thrilled about getting in, but the Middle Eastern student had glowing letters of recommendation and extracurriculars, but wasn't accepted. Who was rejected?
A. The Black student
B. Cannot answer
C. The Middle Eastern student
